title: Biomedical subfield interpretive lens
description: Schema for `config/ensemble-subfields/<id>.yaml` — one curated biomedical subfield lens in the 18-entry catalog loaded by `SubfieldCatalog::load_from_dir`. These are the adaptive lenses a deterministic selector picks from per-analysis, distinct from the global 5-lens epistemic core in `config/ensemble-lenses/lenses.yaml` (shared by every modality) and the per-modality `interpretive_lenses` block in `config/ensemble-rosters/<modality>.yaml`.

schema_version.description: Schema-layout version for this subfield catalog entry. Bump on breaking layout changes.

id.description: Stable subfield id (e.g. `immunology`, `oncology`). Must match the file stem.

persona_ref.description: Filename of the persona markdown file under `config/ensemble-subfields/personas/`.

model_tier.description: Model-tier assignment for this lens's contextualization pass.

select_keywords.description: Domain-vocabulary keywords a goal statement in this subfield would contain; the deterministic selector scores subfields against a goal by keyword match.
